source_qualifications: The 48 publication episodes and 271 commits concern the website repository, not all repositories on the forge (appendix A2).
Zero requests for commits younger than one hour applies to linux-chrome-150-155; other agents did sometimes fetch promptly (appendix A6).
Eleven GitHub-only pushes is the corrected count in the original publication figure and appendix A2; the archived report's nine is superseded.

The essay daily snapshot totals 367972 early HTTP 200 responses. The figure's hourly cube totals 367971 because October 3 differs by one. Both originals are preserved and the distinction is in the speaker notes.
The primary timing test uses successful website-page GETs; the hash analysis includes unsuccessful commit-specific GETs. Their denominators differ.
The figures' records end on October 19, before the October 22 provider reply. The deck does not present the reply as a measured cause of a plotted decline.
Infrastructure registration, user-agent claims, operator identity, and training intent remain distinct. Speculation is attributed to the author.
